annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents POWH3D as an investment opportunity with frequent-return and dividend claims, encourages viewers to invest more for greater dividends, and demonstrates an ETH-for-P3D purchase flow. It directs viewers to join through the speaker’s link and offers an Ethereum reward for using that link and sending transaction details, establishing a referral-linked financial participation and data-request flow. The application’s homepage calls it a smart-pyramid app, although the available video evidence does not establish whether transactions completed, returns were attainable, or viewers experienced losses.

The speaker describes depositing ETH, receiving or expecting dividends, purchasing additional P3D tokens with ETH, and encouraging further investment.
